parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, dealId: $json.dealId, source: $json.evidence_source, stored: $json.stored, next: 'Run WF-012 to build the evidence-first analysis context.' } }}

parameters.bodyParametersJson: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.PERPLEXITY_PROPERTY_MODEL || 'sonar', messages: [{ role:'system', content:'Identify only official government/public-record source URLs for the requested state and county. Do not invent URLs. Return compact JSON: {sources:[{id,type,evidenceType,url,notes}]}.' }, { role:'user', content: $json.source_discovery_query }], temperature: 0.1 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model:$env.PERPLEXITY_PROPERTY_MODEL || 'sonar',messages:[{role:'system',content:'Resolve the county for a US property address. Use authoritative sources where possible. Return JSON only: {county, state, confidence, source_citations:[{url,title}]} . Do not guess.'},{role:'user',content:'Resolve the county for this property: ' + $json.fullAddress}],temperature:0.1}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const state=$json.state; const county=$json.county; if(!state||!county) return [{json:{...$json,valid:false,error:'State/county resolution incomplete'}}]; return [{json:$json}];
